objective: Verify the newly persisted 4h archive branch against the six-year 4h archive, investigate BTC manifest hash divergences, and extend the durable raw archive with all newly completed 5m/15m/1h/4h bars.
hypothesis: The 2026-11-05 raw-ohlcv branch contains a bar-identical overlapping subset of the canonical six-year 4h archive; the BTC page hash flags are manifest-lineage differences rather than OHLCV row differences.
preregistered_checks: Read raw GitHub archive pages and manifests from both research branches.
Compare exact 12-field raw kline arrays by openTime for common symbol/time ranges.

Count duplicate timestamps, missing expected intervals, non-monotonic timestamps, OHLC invariant failures, non-finite values, non-positive volume and close-time alignment errors in newly appended bars.
Exclude every forming candle and append only completed bars.
Persist raw delta, update manifests, fetch them back and verify exact content and SHA-256.

method.overlap_comparison: Exact array equality on rows keyed by openTime; no tolerance or price rounding.
method.runtime: Managed V8 JavaScript Code Mode; no repository harness invoked; deterministic arithmetic; no random seed.

evidence_gates.raw_row_comparison: Zero mismatches across all overlapping rows.
evidence_gates.continuity: Zero duplicates, gaps, non-monotonic timestamps, OHLC failures, non-finite values, non-positive volume or close-time alignment errors in appended rows.
evidence_gates.persistence: GitHub write followed by fetch_file readback; exact byte-for-byte content and SHA-256 equality.
evidence_gates.scope_limit: This is a data-quality experiment, not a strategy backtest or OOS evaluation.
